Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 4

“Arjuna said: Your birth was later; the birth of Vivasvan was earlier. How am I to understand that you taught this in the beginning?”

A fair and literal-minded objection. Arjuna is still seeing his charioteer as a contemporary, and the arithmetic does not work — a question that draws out everything following.
